author: GavinNewsom
text:
This is exactly what I warned would happen last year.

Trump is using mass deportations to TERRORIZE diverse communities out of legally voting — ordering his secret police to “go after everybody.”

Donald, your campaign of fear will FAIL. The American people will NOT be intimidated!
